The kind of a schedule exception — a VALUE, never a subclass.

## Structure

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ExceptionType`](gmeow-ExceptionType.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the value vocabulary the [`gmeow:exceptionType`](../properties/gmeow-exceptionType.md) property ranges over — the open set (cancellation, rescheduling) a schedule exception declares.

### Avoid when

- Avoid modelling these as [`ScheduleException`](gmeow-ScheduleException.md) subclasses; the kind is an individual on this axis, extended by minting new individuals, not subclasses ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

### How to use

- Reference a seeded individual ([`gmeow:exceptionTypeCancellation`](../individuals/gmeow-exceptionTypeCancellation.md), [`gmeow:exceptionTypeRescheduling`](../individuals/gmeow-exceptionTypeRescheduling.md)) from a [`gmeow:ScheduleException`](gmeow-ScheduleException.md) via [`gmeow:exceptionType`](../properties/gmeow-exceptionType.md); add a new individual if a further kind appears.

### Examples

- ex:standupSkip [`gmeow:exceptionType`](../properties/gmeow-exceptionType.md) [`gmeow:exceptionTypeCancellation`](../individuals/gmeow-exceptionTypeCancellation.md).
